brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: ads-marketing / editorial sports illustration.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail, landscape 16:9, preferably 1536x864 or larger, PNG. This is for the Japanese website バスケまとめ.

Visual direction: premium hand-drawn ink and dry-brush sports poster, matching the already viewed approved B-culver-black-lime-v3 reference's rough ink, brush textures, sparse elements and strong Japanese typography. Near-black background #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B brush accent, warm off-white typography and skin highlights. Small orange accent for the ball only. Entirely an illustration, never photorealistic. Do not copy the reference's athlete, names, dates, scores, or pose.

Main subject: exactly one REAL player, Rikiya Yamaguchi / 山口力也, randomly selected from the article's named players. Base his recognizable facial appearance on the official 2026-27 B.LEAGUE profile just inspected: slim long face, prominent ears, short tousled textured ash-brown hair with irregular fringe, fairly narrow dark eyes, straight medium-width nose, thin dark moustache, small distinct goatee on the chin, slender neck, lean athletic build. Keep those identity-specific traits in the ink drawing; do not substitute a generic or invented athlete. The reference photo is for facial observation only, never paste or reproduce any part of a photograph.
Subject clothing: plain sleeveless off-white basketball uniform with charcoal shadows and restrained lime trim, no numbers, no lettering, no team or league logo, no sponsors, no headband.
Pose: energetic low dribble drive, three-quarter view with face clearly visible and eyes looking forward, one hand controlling a single basketball at hip-to-thigh height, other arm naturally bent for balance, torso leaning into motion. Natural anatomy and correctly drawn hands and fingers. This is a conceptual basketball illustration, NOT a reconstruction of a particular game, scoring event or achievement.

Composition: put the athlete on the LEFT 43 percent, drawn from head through upper thighs with intentional lower-body crop; face and both hands fully inside frame. A wide diagonal lime brush swipe behind the athlete creates motion. Keep all headline text in the RIGHT 54 percent, clearly separated from hands, face and ball. Sparse background, no crowd, no other players, no scoreboard. Generous safe margins, approximately 5% of canvas. On the right, a small site title at top, large date below, massive Japanese main headline in off-white, subhead in lime. A readable qualifier line under the title block. A small but legible footer along bottom right.

Render ONLY these exact text lines, each once, clean accurate Japanese lettering:
バスケまとめ
11/01
試合結果
当日のEFF
19:26時点｜一部公式記録未確定
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Typographic hierarchy: "試合結果" is largest, "11/01" and "当日のEFF" secondary. Make the long qualifier much smaller but readable, allowed to wrap between "19:26時点" and "一部公式記録未確定" if necessary. Footer labels are legible and uncut. Never add the player's name, team name, jersey number, individual stats, scores, winners, rankings, personal achievement claims, or extra words. The fixed source article is a multi-game 2026-11-01 results/EFF roundup with some official records still pending as of 19:26 JST; do not suggest all results are final.
No official photographs, logos, sponsor marks, watermark, photographic rendering, fabricated players, or tiny illegible text.

ONE CORRECTION PASS
Edit the FIRST image, the finished basketball thumbnail. The SECOND image is the official 2026-27 profile photograph of the real player Rikiya Yamaguchi (山口力也), used ONLY as a facial identity reference, never pasted into the artwork.

This is the one final correction pass. Keep the same near-black/lime ink-brush illustration style, 16:9 canvas, headline design, and ALL existing Japanese text exactly unchanged:
バスケまとめ
11/01
試合結果
当日のEFF
19:26時点｜一部公式記録未確定
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Correct the player illustration in two precise ways:
1. Fit the player and basketball entirely inside the left illustration area with safe space. Currently the dribbling hand is clipped by the left canvas edge. Slightly reduce and reposition the whole illustrated player/ball group so that every finger of both hands, the whole ball and the top of the hair are fully visible, at least 35 pixels from the canvas edges. Maintain dynamic low dribble pose and allow only the lower thigh to crop at the bottom. Preserve all headline text unchanged.
2. Bring his face clearly closer to the SECOND reference photo while preserving the illustrated rendering: same long slim face and jaw contour, prominent rounded ears, narrow eyes and eyelids, straight brows, medium straight nose, and the shaggy brown hair/fringe shape from the profile. The moustache must be THIN and subtle, and chin hair a small short sparse flat patch, as in the official reference; remove the heavy dark moustache and pointed beard of the current illustration. Use the actual facial proportions rather than a generic manga face. Keep a focused expression suitable for dribbling. He is a lean player, not bulky.

No other people. No names, jersey numbers, scores, stats, team/league logos or sponsor text. Plain uniform. Do not copy any orange uniform graphics, logos, or background from the photo. All pixels in final are an ink illustration, never photographic. No new text. This remains an imagined playing pose, not any documented match moment. Produce exactly one corrected PNG.
